user.title: Connect to the sdsctl App
user.description: Enter the exact internal Home Assistant App DNS alias and the private bridge key shown by the explicit App operator command. No network discovery is performed.

data_description.app_host: Use the installed App name with underscores replaced by hyphens, such as local-sds200. Published repository identifiers are not hard-coded.
data_description.app_port: Keep 8100 unless the first-party App contract changes.
data_description.bridge_key: Stored only in the Home Assistant config entry and sent only to the selected App's private service.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the private sdsctl bridge key
reauth_confirm.description: The configured App rejected the stored key. Enter the replacement printed by the explicit App terminal command.

error.cannot_connect: The exact configured App service is unavailable.
error.incompatible: The App and integration live-audio protocol or format do not match.
error.invalid_auth: The private bridge key was rejected.
error.invalid_input: The App hostname, port, or bridge key has an invalid shape.

abort.already_configured: sdsctl live scanner audio is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The private bridge key was updated.
